Select chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id aliased as indication_curie, efo_term aliased as indication_label, max_phase_for_ind from molecule_dictionary joined with compound_structures on molregno and with drug_indication on molregno. Filter molecule_dictionary max_phase = 4, drug_indication efo_id IS NOT NULL, drug_indication efo_term IS NOT NULL. Return DISTINCT rows. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
